note: Wikimedia Commons, “Icon of Saint Tikhon in Dormition Cathedral, Yaroslavl (Russia).jpg”; artist as recorded there: Pierre André Leclercq — fetched 14 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Found by listing `Category:Icons of Patriarch Tikhon of Moscow`, a subcategory of `Category:Tikhon of Moscow` — this folder's own saint, display name «Tikhon of Moscow», Russian form «Тихон (Белавин)», patriarch and confessor. The file names him and the cathedral it hangs in, and the category it sits in names the patriarchate, which is what distinguishes him from Tikhon of Zadonsk and Tikhon of Amathus. 1243x2678, a single-figure icon. Commons describes it: Commemorative plaque of СВ. ТИХОН Patriarch Tikhon of Moscow in Dormition Cathedral, Yaroslavl (Russia). The figure holds a pastoral stick and wears the clothes of a bishop. Above him appears a small celestial scene, while both sides show Russian churches.
